errors.text_span: Die Balken sind für jedes Alter in vier Kategorien unterteilt
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart. For each age group on the x-axis, there are two bars side-by-side (one for German, one for Other Language). Each of these two bars is then stacked with two segments (Usage and Unmet Need). The description incorrectly implies that there is a single bar for each age that is divided into four parts.

The phrase 'sehr gering' (very low) is a subjective interpretation. While the values for unmet need are low for older children (e.g., 0%, 1%, 4%, 7%), using evaluative language is not a neutral description of the data.
